answer_4.quote: We invite volunteers to assess whether the extracted concepts are biased... We invite the annotators to assess whether the extracted concepts are correct... Each concept is labeled with 0, 1 or 2 by three annotators...
answer_4.guideline: Assessing whether extracted concepts are correct or biased, labeling concepts as 0 (wrong), 1 (existing concept), or 2 (new concept).
